mapping.summary: Live spreadsheets, budgets and financial reports in BC
claims: Sheet areas bind to BC tables, financial reports, budgets, queries and reports
Open any financial report and work with it as a spreadsheet, sliced by dimension and period
Interactive dashboards with slicers, pivot tables, charts and KPI cards
Budget entry in accounts-by-months matrix written to G/L budget entries
Last year's actuals shown beside budget cells
Editable lists with validated editing and calculated columns
Drill down from any number to records or ledger entries
Formulas include SUM, AVERAGE, XLOOKUP and G/L functions
Excel exports come with native charts and tables
Each sheet is shareable with Read Only, Owner or Edit Budget Entries access
Multi-company regions, conditional formatting and what-if scenarios
An AI assistant, if enabled, creates dashboards from a text description
Financial report indicator rows pull data from any table
Reports across companies and consolidates, with currency conversion
Scheduled financial reports in PDF, Excel, Word, HTML or XML, sent to email or SharePoint
Financial reports exposed as API endpoints for Power BI
Online sandboxes run without license key
